Humane Animal Partners (Stanton Campus)

Stanton/Christiana campus, 455 Stanton Christiana Rd. Short-term outing program; 7 days a week. Pickup 9:30-10am, return by 1pm Tue-Sun or 4pm Mon. Must be 18+. Apply via the DDO questionnaire on the page (allow up to a week). No dog parks, leash at all times, no meeting your pets; kids under 18 may join with prior notice. Doggy Night Out (1-2 night sleepovers) case by case for existing DDO volunteers.

Sign up on the shelter's site Call (302) 998-2281
